gotchas: A digital subscription, so no shipping. subscribenow.economist.com lists plans (US region pre-selected, Premium Annual pre-checked); "Continue to payment" opens a three-step checkout: Account, Payment, Review.

A consent dialog (iframe[id^="sp_message_iframe"]) covers the page and takes clicks: press Enter on its Continue button inside that frame. On www.economist.com/subscribe it blocks the plan links; open subscribenow.economist.com directly.

Account step asks for an email first ("we'll create an account for you if you don't already have one"). An email that already has an account shows a password field next: fill it and press Enter. No code was asked. reCAPTCHA (invisible) is on the page.

Payment: click the credit/debit card option to reveal a Zuora hosted iframe (iframe[src*="zuora"]). Card holder name, expiry month and year are <select>s (month as "06", year "2030"), then number and security code. Fill name and expiry first, then number and CVC back to back.
Verified 2026-10-06 through the proxy (US tunnel) with the public test card under a verification-only key: fields filled, no error in the Zuora frame. Stopped before Review/subscribe.
